abstract: Seventy-seven patients with primary malignant testicular tumors were treated in our hospital. Twenty-five of them were given antineoplastic agents containing cis diamine dichloro platinum (CDDP). In three long-term survivors, new malignant testicular tumors developed meta-chronously and had different histological findings from those of the initial tumors. Case 1. A 28-year-old patient with a yolk sac tumor of the left testicle, stage IIO, developed metastasis to the supraclavicular lymph nodes five years after radiation. Chemotherapy containing of VP-16 (837 mg), CDDP (1050 mg), vincristine (32 mg), bleomycin (480 mg), and actinomycin-D (16 mg) achieved complete remission. Four years 11 months later a seminoma of the contralateral testicle, stage I, was disclosed and he died of cancer 11 years and four months after the onset of the initial disease. Case 2. A 30-year-old patient with testicular teratoma, stage IIIA, on the right side gained complete remission after a CDDP containing chemotherapy. One year and four months after the beginning of the CDDP use (1,300 mg totally as CDDP) a seminoma on the contralateral side, stage I, was detected. He died of cancer eight years and two months after his initial tumor was detected. Case 3. A 37-year-old patient with combined tumor of seminoma and yolk sac tumor of the right testicle, stage IIIO, was free from disease for six years and five months under chemotherapy. At this point a seminoma, stage I, of the contralateral testicle was newly found and treated by radiation.(ABSTRACT TRUNCATED AT 250 WORDS)
abstract_ja: 77例の原発性悪性精巣腫瘍患者を当科で治療した。そのうち25例はシス-ジアミン-ジクロロ白金(CDDP)を含む抗腫瘍薬による治療を受けた。長期生存者3例において、新たな悪性精巣腫瘍が異時性に発生し、初発腫瘍とは組織像の異なるものであった。症例1：左精巣卵黄嚢腫瘍(病期IIO)の28歳男性。放射線療法の5年後に鎖骨上リンパ節転移を生じた。VP-16(837mg)、CDDP(1050mg)、ビンクリスチン(32mg)、ブレオマイシン(480mg)、アクチノマイシンD(16mg)を含む化学療法で完全寛解を得た。その4年11か月後に対側精巣のセミノーマ(病期I)が発見され、初発から11年4か月後に原病で死亡した。症例2：右精巣奇形腫(病期IIIA)の30歳男性。CDDP含有化学療法で完全寛解を得た。CDDP使用開始の1年4か月後に対側のセミノーマ(病期I)が検出され、初発から8年2か月後に死亡した。症例3：右精巣のセミノーマと卵黄嚢腫瘍の混合腫瘍(病期IIIO)の37歳男性。化学療法下で5年5か月無病であった。その時点で対側精巣に新たなセミノーマ(病期I)が発見され、放射線療法で治療された。(抄録は250語で切り詰められている)
